entries.invariant: Indices resolve before mutation, callbacks see their argument window, results are adjusted including multiple results, and failed growth preserves the live prefix and later calls.
entries.boundaries: Macros must be checked through the pinned headers and their expanded public calls. Merely compiling the macro name does not establish its observable stack effect.

entries.invariant: Raw operations preserve actual key/object identity and bypass handlers; registry/global roots remain live, and public metatable access bypasses Lua protection strings.
entries.boundaries: Warning-state registry ownership and FILE metatable lookup additionally use these operations. Review barrier/root safety through collector regressions, not only a raw read-back.

entries.invariant: Callbacks receive owned argument windows and captured cells, protected errors retain exact values, nested callbacks recover, and non-yieldable calls return synchronously without invoking their supplied continuation.
entries.boundaries: Only the synchronous/non-yieldable API paths directly exercised by this batch are candidates. Yieldable C continuations, C coroutine resumption and the remaining full ABI stay pending. Foreign jumps must never cross active Ada frames.

requirements: Bind result.json and every stdout/stderr capture by SHA256 plus clean revision and exact context/configuration/profile/library type.
Require mapped terminal witnesses exactly once, final consumer marker and exit0/no timeout/empty stderr.
Cold constructor sweep prints measured growth count; require positive integer without hardcoded platform count. Loop checks every refusal and zero allocator residue before print.
GC and IO captures have matching C-oracle counterparts; verify actual captured-byte equality and source identities.
Supporting cases remain supporting; witness union cannot broaden original mapping boundaries.
